text:
Maya: Heads up — we hit a small snag in the v2 migration lane. Need quick ownership clarifications for the remaining E2E smoke and SDK catchups.

Chris: which snag?

Maya: Deploys to staging show 502s from the edge when the flag flips to v2 for requests with pinned model param. Logs show `UnknownRouteError`.

Sam: I pushed a hotfix to the shim last night — replaced a failing proto deserializer. Deployment succeeded but SDK tests still failing for python client.

Jordan: @Sam can you point to the PR? I can run integration tests against dedicated and private infra.

Sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4321 — failing test is `test_streaming_chunk_boundary` in python client. Works locally w/ `--run-slow`.

deploy-bot: staging deploy started for sha @ 0a1b2c3

Maya: Ownership: Eng-runtime to triage runtime path; Eng-platform to coordinate rollout plan and canary slice; DevEx to prioritize SDK patch. Can someone confirm?

Chris: I'll take eng-platform rollout and canary slice. I'll own the staging cutover and smoke run.

Jordan: I'll own eng-runtime triage. Starting root cause now, will update in thread. ETA 2-3 hrs.

DevEx: I'll schedule SDK patch review, pinging @Sam for test repro steps. Also creating a temporary doc in #docs with steps.

Sam: repro steps: run `pytest tests/test_streaming.py::test_streaming_chunk_boundary -k chunk -s` with env `REDWOOD_ENV=staging` and `STREAM_TIMEOUT=5`. Attaching small log snippet: ```json
{"err":"UnknownRouteError","route":"/v2/generate","host":"edge-1"}
```

Chris: For rollout: propose canary 5% traffic, monitor 99p latency and `5xx_rate` on edge. If `5xx_rate` > 0.5% rollback. Thoughts?

Jordan: that rollback threshold seems fine. If cause is proto mismatch, will push a patch that adds fallback to legacy header parsing.

Maya: OK final ask: list outstanding deps and owners: runtime triage - Jordan; platform rollout - Chris; SDK PR review - DevEx/Sam; QA smoke - Maya. Add any other blockers.

DevEx: Noted. I'll also add an item for docs update and example migration snippet in `python` and `js`.

Sam: small note — customers using `pin_model` may hit this. We should notify sales/customer-success if we need to short-circuit any orgs.

Chris: I'll open a one-pager for CS and mark SEs for customers with heavy pin usage.

Jordan: quick update — found bad route rewrite rule in proxy config for certain headers, creating a config diff now. If I can replicate in staging, patch in <1hr.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded for sha @ 0a1b2c3 (build 2024-11-03T09:12Z)

Maya: Great. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: Please post any logs here. I'll check back at 1600.
